So Friday and today I hit up my combo stocked ponds, one has Splake(hybrid Lake trout/brook(Speckled) trout), the other is a Brook trout pond.

I started off around 10am(shortly after first light up here) at the splake pond, This lake is spring fed crystal clear to 20 feet, I could see Splake all over the place[pic 2], Couldn't get them to pay attention to anything, I threw spinners, and spoons and jigs, I brought worms and minnows, and plastics, I through jerkbaits, I jigged I casted I trolled, I through bobbers with plain hooks and bait, I through that berkley powerbait shit even, they ignored me, they wouldn't get spooked or anything even if I dragged my lure right infront of their nose they literally just turned their heads at it and ignored it. at first I saw them all just sitting "sleeping" in about 5 or 6 feet of water, I saw them everywhere, all over the shoreline, I even saw my nemesis skullhead on both days in 2 different areas of the lake, he's a monster Splake with a white mark on his head, like a scrape or something, he's about 8-10+lbs and hangs out with 4 or 5 other ones about 3-5lbs, he's the biggest one I've seen, biggest I caught was 6lbs.

anyways after an hour so of seeing these "sleeping fish", I rolled up joint and hooked up a spinner to troll(paddling nows because my battery for my motor is kaput), so I'm paddling and trolling a spinner and a worm and I notice it, and everything clicks, All the Splake are matched up in pairs, either a male and a female or 2 males and a female. Anyways I packed up around 3pm from the Splake pond and moved to the Brookie pond, a guy I know from town that runs the local outdooors store was out there too, I buy my work boots and gloves and my machete and all kinds of stuf from him, he also sells mountain bikes and bike supplies and works on kids bikes around town, really cool guy.
